scope: Prevent webcam mux service loss after ROS master restart; no flight/arming/control or estimator changes
root_cause: Mux watchdog checked master PID only. Container ROS master PID reuse left the mux process alive while /recorder/start and /recorder/stop were absent from the new master. Camera nodes already had a node-URI guard; mux did not.

checks: Own node name resolves to this process XML-RPC URI
Both start and stop services resolve to this process ROSRPC URI
implementation.response: Exit when ownership/registration is lost; existing Restart=always supervisor restarts and re-registers. Temporary master unreachability is retried.
implementation.recovery_budget_note: Approximately 17s once master is reachable, plus node initialization; no video is recovered retroactively.

reproduced: Replacement ROS master process advertising identical PID 85
Service-only removal while node URI registration remains
validation.fake_camera_fanout: Both start and stop succeed before restart, after supervised relaunch, and after service-only loss recovery. No actual camera devices used.

deployment.method: Reload only the owned mux process through its existing systemd Restart=always supervisor; existing camera services untouched.

preserved_user_state: Existing dirty webcam calibration and historical recording moves left untouched
Deleted incomplete session was not recreated
